snippet.title: Dolor’s Dwelling Teaser
snippet.description:
Uncover the story behind the Dolor family in this hand-animated metroidvania.

Explore a huge interconnected mansion searching for clues over what happend to the residents of the place. All while collecting upgrades and fighting old ghosts along the way.
